title: finding(core,react): the render path skips the zod root parse — a key retired on the published mirror is still ACCEPTED at render time, and in a production build nothing validates at all
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`, carrying residual **4** of card objectui#9659 — the one that card ruled out of its own scope as *"the only one of the four with a possible product question in it"*, landing in a different package.

⚠️ **Why the seat filed this and not the dev.** The dispatch told the dev to file it; the standing dev contract says a dev does not create issues and hands the finding to the seat with dedupe words. **The dev was right, declined, and declared the conflict rather than resolving it silently either way.** ⇒ the dispatch was wrong; the filing is the seat's. Recorded because the dispatch template is what needs fixing.

## The finding

`@object-ui/core`'s `validateSchema` runs **hand-written structural rules only** — it never consults the zod root parse. `SchemaRenderer` calls it behind a `__DEV__` guard (`packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx:73` — `if (!__DEV__ || !schema || typeof schema !== 'object')`).

⇒ a retirement delivered through the zod face is delivered at **parse time** and at **compile time**, and **not at render time**. ⚠️ And in a **production build nothing validates at all**.

Measured first-hand on the objectui#9659 branch against `safeValidateSchema` on the same documents: a `chatbot` node whose retired `body` holds a well-formed node, an array of nodes, a string or a number is **ACCEPTED by the render path at BOTH depths** while the zod parse **REFUSES** it — 4 of 6 probed shapes, plus the nested form. **Firing controls** fire (`null`, a typeless child, a numeric `visible`); **absent control** clean (a `chatbot` without `body` is accepted by both readers, and the remedy spelling `requestBody` is accepted by both).

⭐ **The refinement worth the card, which objectui#9659's wording does not state:** one shape — a **record** body — IS refused by the render path, but **for an unrelated reason**. It walks `body` as a children channel and reports `schema.children.type: type is required`. ⇒ even the apparent coverage is **accidental** and never names the retirement. A reader who probed only that shape would conclude the render path enforces something it does not.

## ⛔ What this does NOT claim

- ⛔ The retirement is **not** paper. Parse time and compile time are real surfaces, and `objectui validate` / `objectui check` refuse the document. The gap is an author who runs neither and still renders.
- ⛔ No claim that any document in this repo, or a sibling repo, actually drives that path with a retired key. **NOT MEASURED.**
- ⛔ This card takes no position on whether the render path *should* agree. That is the product question.

## ⚠️ Prior art — read this before grading, it is substantial

`.changeset/8572-chatbot-body-retired.md:56-76` **already documents this skip**, with its own measured example and firing controls, and closes with:

> ⇒ the retirement is delivered where documents are AUTHORED and CHECKED (`tsc`, `objectui validate`, `objectui check`, and any consumer that calls `safeValidateSchema`), and ⛔ not where they are RENDERED. **Making the render path agree is a different change on a different package and is not made here.**

⇒ the **fact** is on record and was deliberately scoped out. What does **not** exist is a **carrier**: that text names no card, and objectui#9659 (which routed it here) closes on its own PR's merge. ⭐ So this card is the carrier, ⛔ not a rediscovery — and if triage finds an existing open card for it, this one is the duplicate and should be closed as such.

## Landing point, and why it is not this lane's to dispatch

The change would land in **`@object-ui/core`** (and possibly `packages/react`), ⛔ not in `packages/types`. Routing is triage's.

## Readings

Structural legs re-verified by this seat on `origin/main` `e89aae323`: the `__DEV__` guard at `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx:73`, and `validateSchema` declared in `packages/core/src/validation/schema-validator.js` as a hand-written walker. The per-shape acceptance table is the objectui#9659 dev's, taken first-hand on its branch with the controls named above; ⛔ this seat did not re-run it.

Dedupe words: `validateSchema` · `SchemaRenderer` · `root parse` · `render-time` · `@object-ui/core`
